name: More Menu
description: Round hamburger button that morphs into a close icon and opens a small dropdown of icon actions with a springy scale-in and staggered item reveal.
contents: Circular hamburger toggle button with ring glow
Dropdown list of icon and label actions with dividers, including a danger item
behavior: Hamburger lines morph into an X when open
Button pulses on open and glows on hover
Menu scales in from the button corner and items slide in with a stagger
Clicking outside closes the menu, selecting an item calls onSelect and closes it
editableByProps: Menu items, labels, icons and danger flag
Button, menu, item and ring colors
Sizes, radius, font size, stagger timing and open direction

needsCodeEdit.change: Hamburger line thickness and morph easing

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
